ios.desc:
Track business mileage automatically. Keep your drives organized for tax deductions, reimbursements and your accountant.

MileWiz helps freelancers, independent contractors and small business owners keep a clear mileage log without the daily paperwork. From client visits to deliveries, keep business miles separate from personal driving and the details together for your IRS tax records.

AUTOMATIC TRACKING
Record drives in the background, then review your routes, dates, times and distances. Add trips manually when needed.

BUSINESS OR PERSONAL? JUST SWIPE
Quickly categorize trips with a swipe. Set up work hours and saved places to help classify regular drives automatically, then review and adjust them as needed.

MORE THAN A MILEAGE TOTAL
Add a business purpose and client tags so you can remember why you drove. Record parking, tolls and other trip expenses. Manage multiple vehicles and their odometer readings in one place.

CLEAR REPORTS, READY TO SHARE
Choose a date range and filter by category, client tag, vehicle or place. Export PDF or CSV reports for your accountant, your records or a reimbursement request. Set custom mileage rates to match your needs.

FREE TO START
Automatically track up to 20 trips each month for free. Need more? Choose a monthly or annual Unlimited Driving subscription. Prices and billing periods are shown before purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within the final 24 hours of that period. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Automatic tracking requires location access. Review your records before using them for a claim. Tax eligibility and reimbursement depend on your circumstances and the applicable rules.
